name: module-size-signal
body: The indicative size of a first-party source file — roughly 400 lines of production code — used as a SIGNAL for decomposition review rather than a target. A file above the signal prompts inspection of whether its responsibilities are cohesive and of whether a split serves them; the number itself stands apart from any acceptance threshold, and a change that splits a file to fall under it while cohesion stays flat violates the decomposition law. Test code is accounted separately and lies outside the signal's accounting.
